remarks: Live in the heart of downtown Greenwich in this beautifully rebuilt one-bedroom residence on iconic Greenwich Avenue. Recently reconstructed from the studs, this third-floor walk-up offers a bright, loft-like feel with soaring 10+ foot ceilings and oversized windows that flood the home with natural light. The stylish kitchen features stainless steel appliances, quartz countertops, and custom built-ins, while gleaming hardwood floors, central air, and in-unit laundry add everyday comfort and convenience. Just moments from the Greenwich train station and surrounded by the Avenue's renowned shopping and dining, with parks, the harbor, beaches, Bruce Park, and the Bruce Museum all nearby. A wonderful opportunity to enjoy the best of downtown Greenwich right outside your door.

facts.laundryLoc: Stacked w/d in closet in kitchen.
